svg.title: Tutorial production workflow
svg.desc: Four stages: plan and approve the script; derive shared timing from voice; compose picture, captions, presenter and sound; render, inspect and deliver. A dashed feedback path returns failed reviews to the shared timeline.
svg.text: The tutorial workflow: explicit artifacts, shared timing and measured review.
Keep the musical drop on a bar
Review failures return to timing and composition; update the source, preview the change, then render again.
Optional presenter assets are shown in the composition stage. Each check is run and inspected before delivery.
